P.name: Stone Skin
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Wukong''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|{{pp|6 + (10-6)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' armor}}|armor}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{fd|0.35}}% of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{fd|{{ap|0.35/10}}}}% of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}

Whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}} with his {{tip|basic attacks}} or {{tip|abilities}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Strength of Stone'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
P.description2: {{sbc|Strength of Stone:}} For each stack,{{ft|''Stone Skin's'' effects are increased by 100%,|'''Wukong''' gains {{as|{{pp|6 to 10}} '''additional bonus''' armor|armor}} and further regenerates an additional {{as|{{fd|0.35}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} every 5 seconds,}}up to a maximum of {{as|{{pp|6*(1+1*5) + (10*(1+1*5)-6*(1+1*5))/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' armor}} and total additional regeneration of{{ft|{{as|{{ap|0.35*6}}% '''maximum''' health}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{ap|0.35*6/10}}% '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}

Q.name: Crushing Blow
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and then inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 3 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Crushing Blow's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy.
Q.description3: ''Crushing Blow {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Wukong's''' and his {{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone's}} basic attack timer. Other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.''

W.name: Warrior Trickster
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' enters {{tip|invisibility}} for 1 second and {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a {{tip|clone}} of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.
W.description2: The clone is {{tip|untargetable}} to allies and can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy '''Wukong''' damaged. It can also gain the effects of ''{{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}}'' and ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, and casts ''{{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}}'' whenever '''Wukong''' does.
W.description4: ''See [[Wukong#Pets|Pets]] for more details about '''Wukong's''' clone. '''Wukong''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

E.name: Nimbus Strike
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location and sends out {{tip|untargetable}} ''clones'' to strike up to two additional enemies near the target's location, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
E.description2: Upon arrival, '''Wukong''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Cyclone
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' spins his staff around for up to 2 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|20% '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}. The staff deals {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies hit, and can {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} once for {{fd|0.6}} seconds. ''Cyclone'' will not {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies who were already hit by either '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' within the same cast.
R.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|8/8 to 16/8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|275/8}}% AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 16}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 275% AD)}}}}
R.description2: ''Cyclone'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or by casting another {{tip|ability}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Wukong''' ends ''Cyclone''. After 1 second, he can cast ''Cyclone'' a second time within 8 seconds of the first cast.
R.leveling3: {{st|Maximum Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|8*2 to 16*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|275*2}}% AD)}}}}
R.description4: ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} duration is continuously refreshed while spinning.
R.description5: ''Cyclone's'' damage is capped at {{pp|200 to 600 for 3|6;11;16}} per second against {{tip|monsters}}.
